node: Image2SceneGraph canonical five-field equal matching and Luna scoring; image macro over all 1000 images.
parent: Direct parent edges from the node assignment, including ROOT; image macro.
spatial: Image2SceneGraph direction/alignment/overlap/box-distance; pool relation counts within image, then image macro.
fields: Matched applicable reference fields; five weights all 0.2, renormalized when text/palette do not apply.
failed_generation: retain all confirmed generation failures as empty predictions and zero scores
hierarchy_policy: semantic unit policy 1.6; image plus immutable elements, construction and independent review, compiled group types/boxes/colors/descriptions
empty_element_review: Original empty-element predictions are retained and validated deterministically, with no invented groups or independent model review; per-score hierarchy_review_methods identifies this exception.
group_description: Role/family and up to three actual leaf visual-description exemplars; no cross-image information.
spatial_aggregation: Arithmetic mean over 1000 images of pooled F1 across the four spatial relation types
proximity_scoring: Positive Boolean is_near edges: F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN). False/false pairs do not earn credit.
spatial_selection: Evaluation reconstructs complete geometric relations from the benchmark node sets; the downloadable main dataset stores selected spatial records.
